case_proofs.name: default_positive
case_proofs.evidence: Actual default descriptor spans the original four-second action envelope; authorized terminal, v2 closure, one registered artifact, SETTLED and unchanged four-second charge.

case_proofs.name: autonomous_short_lease
case_proofs.evidence: Parent receives no frames and sends no STOP before observing supervisor pidfd exit. Real worker with SIGTERM handler returning zero and setsid descendant both exit; actual closure reaps at least two, expiry/STOP true, interrupted, empty result sets, SETTLED with original charge.

case_proofs.name: natural_close_then_slow_prepare
case_proofs.evidence: Real prepare_artifacts returns after actual natural closure; transparent wrapper waits past actual deadline. Expiry cleanup commits interrupted with closure.stop_requested=false and lease_expired=false preserved, no published results.

case_proofs.name: registered_then_expiry
case_proofs.evidence: Real artifact registration occurs in actual writer before transparent delay. Gate rejects normal terminal, SQL rolls back, prepared effect and task guard persist, second harvest cannot overwrite. Fresh F classifies RUNNING as retained with no settlement and claim unchanged.

case_proofs.name: commit_response_expiry
case_proofs.evidence: Real sqlite3.Connection.commit commits actual TERMINAL before delayed response reaches deadline. HOLD preserves actual terminal/prepared/task guard, no committed.json; new Python F cannot settle or claim.

case_proofs.name: confirm_response_expiry
case_proofs.evidence: Actual confirm_effect creates committed.json before delayed response reaches deadline. Post-confirm gate holds while guard remains; actual committed receipt is acknowledged, new Python F remains HOLD and BOUND.

case_proofs.name: supervisor_loss
case_proofs.evidence: Only the immediately captured supervisor pidfd is killed. Deadline passes; no fabricated tree/terminal, live native owner holds, new Python F retains RUNNING and cannot claim. This case uses a direct worker; escaped-descendant autonomy is covered separately.

case_proofs.name: descriptor_mutation
case_proofs.evidence: Frozen independent mutation test now preserves the original persisted descriptor and forbids GO after a real prepare wrapper requests a one-second renewal. Initial actual candidate failure and complete source snapshot are separately preserved.

fixture_corrections.audit_draft_note: The initial audit script's guessed whole-file assertion index 27 was wrong (7c1cff exit 1). No test was changed in response; f85f8a uses actual per-function assertion comparisons and verifies exactly one correction in each step.

read_only_review.actual_candidate_issue: Native passed its local descriptor dict into prepare, compared READY against that same mutable dict, then used it for RUNNING. This was actually reproduced, source captured and corrected by root.
read_only_review.fixed_mutability: Current native passes a detached descriptor, compares READY to captured owner.binding and constructs RUNNING from captured owner.binding.
read_only_review.configuration_boundary: Root additionally captures normalized lease configuration in the native owner and rechecks it without invoking the whole admission callback during stop. This was a static review recommendation, not a second historical or independent actual red.
read_only_review.transaction_boundary: Current watch explicitly accepts its captured LAUNCHING/RUNNING/TERMINAL states without changing require_current defaults. Actual pre/post-commit and pre/post-confirm time checks remain inside the no-age task guard.
read_only_review.limits: No new receipt/table is needed for the exercised late-confirm window. Do not generalize it to every possible guard-release failure: an existing rmdir-then-fsync failure need not leave the directory.

safety_and_limits: Real SQLite/native/supervisor and CLOCK_BOOTTIME; transparent time-delay wrappers delegate the actual storage operation, not a fabricated receipt.
Signals only through captured authenticated test-owned pidfds; no host-wide process scan, raw-PID signaling, GPU or provider.
Fixture cleanup removes only its cleanup-list entry after actual OS closure. Unknown product owners, receipts and budget states are not erased; fixture cleanup is never settlement proof.
Fresh subprocess checks invoke actual F and scheduler claim, not full foreground CLI. Root separately owns actual CLI and Domain observation coverage.
Missing new APIs were not run as historical red requirements. New public metadata and autonomous expiry are implementation requirements; earlier original behavior evidence remains separately dated.
The fixed eight-case run is a bounded independent result, not a complete C3 suite, deployment, universal recovery or research-benefit claim.
